AfroBot USA

01

The pilot

AfroBot USA started in McKinney, Texas, in 2024. About 30 students took part. Five to six teams built solutions together, and parents worked closely with them.

02

Teams building together

The teams shared tables and built side by side. This clip and photo are from that day.

03

Families in the room

Parents were in the work with the teams. This is the Build Day group.

04

What we learned

Parents were in the room with the teams. The public record of that day is the film and the photographs on this page. A written account of what the children learned is not on this page yet.

05

What's next

The 2027 season in Dallas–Fort Worth scales the 2024 pilot to about 15 teams and about 90 students. Ages stay on Programs. The hubs stay on Competitions.

Register your interest

Proposed

2027 Plan

The 2027 season in Dallas–Fort Worth scales the 2024 pilot to about 15 teams and about 90 students. Teams build small humanoid robots from open-source schematics and 3D-printed parts. AfroBot is also hosting a Yaoundé event on a separate date.

  1. Season kickoff

    August 2027

  2. Washington DC and Maryland

    2027

  3. Atlanta

    2027

  4. Houston

    2027

  5. Dallas–Fort Worth

    2027

  6. National championship

    Dallas, April 2028
